ANDed with the input byte, XOR imm bit i. Two

failed at 937,330 and 992,235 mismatches and were
discarded; the filed model is the one that matches

ifma_model_differential.method: semantics vs the mod-2^32 add chain
ifma_model_differential.note: The VPMADD52 instruction itself was not
executed; equivalence rests on the z3 proof over
the arithmetic semantics (proofs record L6) plus
this model differential. Labelled as such.
